view.desc: Defines how your layout components (header/footer/drawer) should be placed on screen; See docs examples
view.descCn: 定义布局组件（页眉/页脚/抽屉）在屏幕上的放置方式；请参阅文档示例

container.desc: Containerize the layout which means it changes the default behavior of expanding to the whole window; Useful (but not limited to) for when using on a QDialog
container.descCn: 将布局容器化，这意味着它改变了默认的扩展到整个窗口的行为；在使用 QDialog 时特别有用（但不限于此）

resize.desc: Emitted when layout size (height, width) changes
resize.descCn: 当布局大小（高度、宽度）发生变化时触发

scroll.desc: Emitted when user scrolls within layout
scroll.descCn: 当用户在布局内滚动时触发

position.descCn: 从顶部开始的滚动偏移量（垂直）

directionChanged.desc: Has scroll direction changed since event was last emitted?
directionChanged.descCn: 自上次触发事件以来滚动方向是否发生改变？

delta.desc: Vertical delta distance since event was last emitted
delta.descCn: 自上次触发事件以来的垂直距离变化

inflectionPoint.descCn: 从顶部开始的滚动偏移量（垂直）

scroll-height.desc: Emitted when the scroll size of layout changes
scroll-height.descCn: 当布局的滚动大小发生变化时触发
